## Design Decision

* [MadEvent σ references: independent seeds, recorded iterations, equal-weight recombination](D1-reference-error-design.md) - Proposed: every gated MadEvent σ reference banks fresh-directory seeds at two budgets and keeps each channel's iterations; the gate reads the equal-weight recombination, with the measured seed scatter folded into its error.
